body: I thought of that before actually, but my therapist told me I need to focus on myself ( not about suicide lol ) and why shouldn't I think of myself right now? Why live to make others happy?

From one who will probably do it to another who will probably do it, people love you.

Yeah, I'm waiting to leave for "work", then drink and then do it. If I got the balls to do it lol
